height_metric: Maximum numerator or denominator bit length among A,B,Px,Py,Rx,Ry, with integer denominators 1 and bit_length(0)=0.
admission_rule: A positive public-relation event is admitted at a cap if at least one of its 27 frozen candidates has full-witness height <= cap and both rational points reduce to its specified U,V. Record centered-baseline admission and all-candidate admission separately. A control with public nonrelation is never admitted even when a rational witness fits the cap; count such bounded mismatched candidates separately.
selection: Preserve all 127 public-relation events and 32 preselected public nonrelation controls, their source order, all 27 candidates per event, and every cap result. The panel is a retrospective fixed-input height-cap analysis.
measurement: exact bounded candidate admission counts only; no same-target online wall-time or public-relation search comparison
